display.name: Netlify
display.blurb: Inspect and manage Netlify sites, deploys, builds, forms and DNS during a run — authenticated with a personal access token brokered at the egress proxy, never seen by the agent.

cli.doc:
Use `netlify` to inspect and manage Netlify from this session via the REST API (https://api.netlify.com/api/v1). Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects your personal access token (Bearer) on every request to api.netlify.com; `NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT run any login or set a real token.

Each subcommand needs the matching power on your profile — a call to a path your profile didn't grant is denied at the network boundary, not authenticated.

Identity / accounts:
  netlify whoami                          Current user (GET /user) — needs `account:read`.
  netlify accounts                        List accounts (GET /accounts) — needs `account:read`.
Sites (needs `sites:read`, or `sites:write` to mutate):
  netlify sites                           List your sites.
  netlify site <site-id>                  Show one site.
  netlify create-site name=<n> [field=value ...]   Create a site (POST).
  netlify delete-site <site-id>           Delete a site.
Deploys (`deploys:read` / `deploys:write`):
  netlify deploys <site-id>               List a site's deploys.
  netlify deploy <deploy-id>              Show one deploy.
  netlify restore <deploy-id>            Restore (roll back to) a deploy (POST).
Builds (`builds:read` / `builds:write`):
  netlify builds <site-id>                List a site's builds.
  netlify build <site-id>                 Trigger a build (POST).
Forms (`forms:read`):
  netlify forms <site-id>                 List a site's forms.
Env vars (`env:read` / `env:write`):
  netlify env <account-id> [site_id=<id>] List account-level env vars.
DNS (`dns:read`):
  netlify dns                             List DNS zones.
Generic passthrough:
  netlify get  <path> [field=value ...]   Raw GET  https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/<path> (query params).
  netlify api  <METHOD> <path> [field=value ...]   Raw call with a JSON body from field=value pairs.
<path> is relative to /api/v1 (e.g. `netlify get sites` or `netlify api POST sites name=demo`). Responses are JSON, pretty-printed when jq is present.
